title: AlignedHPO: Efficient Surrogate-Guided Loss Hyperparameter Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.22658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern deep learning losses involve multiple hyperparameters, such as weights, scales, and margins, typically tuned manually or through expensive black-box optimization despite their differentiability. We propose AlignedHPO, an efficient framework for tuning differentiable loss hyperparameters using gradient alignment and surrogate validation objectives. Our method employs Jacobian-vector products to reduce hypergradient computation time and memory, while differentiable metric surrogates guide optimization toward task-specific evaluation criteria. We address gradient magnitude ambiguity and stochastic instability through normalized alignment and gradient smoothing. Experiments with generalized Focal Loss and ArcFace demonstrate effective adaptation across long-tailed classification and open-set face recognition. translated_title: AlignedHPO：高效的代理引导损失超参数优化
translated_abstract: 现代深度学习损失函数涉及多个超参数，例如权重、尺度和边距，尽管这些超参数具有可微性，但通常仍通过手动调整或昂贵的黑盒优化方法进行调优。我们提出了AlignedHPO，一个利用梯度对齐和代理验证目标来高效调优可微损失超参数的框架。我们的方法采用雅可比-向量积来降低超梯度计算的时间和内存开销，同时可微的度量代理引导优化朝着特定任务的评估标准进行。我们通过归一化对齐和梯度平滑解决了梯度幅度歧义和随机不稳定问题。在广义Focal Loss和ArcFace上的实验表明，该方法在长尾分类和开集人脸识别任务中均能实现有效适应。与隐式微分方法相比，AlignedHPO取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能，同时超梯度计算速度提升近12倍。
tldr: AlignedHPO提出了一种利用梯度对齐和可微代理验证目标的高效损失超参数优化框架，通过雅可比-向量积与归一化对齐等技术，在保持竞争力性能的同时将超梯度计算速度提升近12倍，成功应用于长尾分类和开集人脸识别任务。
en_tdlr: AlignedHPO is an efficient framework for tuning differentiable loss hyperparameters via gradient alignment and differentiable surrogate validation objectives, achieving competitive performance compared to implicit differentiation with nearly 12x faster hypergradient computation, validated on long-tailed classification and open-set face recognition.
